name: Fix typo and update title in a meeting agenda PDF
prompt: I have a meeting agenda PDF at meeting-agenda.pdf. It has two problems: (1) 'Enginering' in the subtitle is misspelled — it should be 'Engineering', and (2) the title says 'Weekly Team Meeting' but this is actually our monthly all-hands, so change it to 'Monthly All-Hands Meeting'. Please edit the PDF directly and save the result as edited-agenda.pdf.

criteria.description: edited-agenda.pdf file is present in the working directory.
PDF text contains "monthly" and "all-hands" and no longer contains "weekly team meeting".
PDF text contains "engineering" (correct spelling) and does not contain the misspelling "enginering".
Original agenda items (sprint, code review, roadmap) are still present in the edited PDF.
edited-agenda.pdf is a readable PDF containing at least 1 page.

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent was asked to edit a PDF meeting agenda to fix a typo ('Enginering' -> 'Engineering') and change the title from 'Weekly Team Meeting' to 'Monthly All-Hands Meeting'.

Criterion 1: Correct Edits (Weight: 60%)
1.0: Both edits are correctly applied — the typo is fixed and the title is updated. The rest of the document content (agenda items, date, footer) is preserved.
0.5: One edit is correct but the other is missing or wrong, or some original content was lost.
0: Neither edit was applied, or the output PDF is fundamentally broken/unreadable.

Criterion 2: Tool Usage (Weight: 40%)
1.0: The agent used nano-pdf (or equivalent PDF-editing CLI tool) to edit the PDF directly rather than recreating it from scratch.
0.5: The agent recreated the PDF from scratch using a PDF library, losing the original formatting/layout.
0: No output PDF was produced.

Final score: weighted average of all criteria.
eval.name: Quality Judge
